##### Project general facts

Joud Tower by Albatha Real Estate is a landmark residential tower that combines elegant, functional architecture with sweeping views of the city skyline and the surrounding lakes. The tower rises above a basement, a ground floor and six podium levels to forty-eight residential floors and a roof. It offers two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, three- and four-bedroom homes with private gardens at podium level, four-bedroom duplex villas on the upper floors and bespoke five-bedroom penthouses with private pools.

Amenities are designed for families and an active lifestyle. Residents can use separate gymnasiums with a sauna and steam room for men and women, an adult swimming pool and a kids' pool, a padel court and a running track. A kids' play area, a nursery, a multipurpose hall, a cafe and prayer rooms complete the shared facilities, while extensive retail space on the ground floor brings everyday shopping and services directly to the doorstep of the building.

Interiors are modern and stylish, with spacious living rooms and bedrooms filled with natural light and finished in high-quality materials. Every apartment is a smart home, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens with the latest appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste. Penthouses are planned with separate areas for families and guests. Round-the-clock concierge, restricted smart access, a separate delivery circulation and a full on-site maintenance team ensure comfort and privacy.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Mamzar is a waterfront residential district of Sharjah set between Al Mamzar Lake and Al Khan Lake, right on the border with Dubai. The area offers open water views, waterfront promenades and a lively urban setting, with Al Khan, Al Majaz and the cultural heart of Sharjah close by, alongside parks, schools, clinics and a wide choice of shopping and dining options.

The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Sharjah Expo Centre are within walking distance of the area. Al Ittihad Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport, while Sharjah International Airport, Al Majaz Waterfront and Al Qasba are a short drive away, making daily commuting between both emirates convenient.

Sharjah offers freehold ownership to all nationalities in designated areas, and lakefront addresses close to the Dubai border are in steady demand. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with spacious family layouts and direct connections to both emirates, support consistent demand from residents and tenants. A landmark tower with premium amenities and retail at its base strengthens the area's long-term appeal for investors and end users.
